Independent Skipio, Polar and FED refrigeration repairs

One failed prep fridge can disrupt an entire shift. A chef needs chilled ingredients within reach, counter staff need saleable products at the correct temperature and a manager needs to know whether the affected cabinet can be returned to service without compromising food safety. That is a more complicated decision than simply switching the unit off and on again.

Fridge Repairs Blacktown provides independent commercial refrigeration assistance across Blacktown and Western Sydney, including enquiries for Skipio, Polar and FED equipment. We assess temperature instability, display and underbench cooling faults, damaged closures, controller problems, recurrent ice accumulation and leaks. Send us the brand, exact model and symptoms so we can confirm the appropriate service capability and availability for your cabinet.

Our advertised call-out fee begins at $69; confirm the commercial or urgent attendance charge for your job. We provide a quotation after diagnosis, before approved repair work. Same-day attendance may be available and eligible repairs have a parts and labour warranty of up to 12 months, subject to confirmed terms. Call 0433 633 731, request commercial refrigeration assistance online or email info@fridgerepairblacktown.com.au.

​Independent service: we are not affiliated with Skipio, Polar or FED and do not perform their authorised warranty service.

Choose the type of equipment that needs attention

A refrigeration fault should be assessed against the job the cabinet was designed to perform. A drinks display, an upright kitchen freezer and a refrigerated preparation station have different working patterns. Even two cabinets made by the same manufacturer may use different controllers, airflow routes, door hardware and refrigeration assemblies.

​

Skipio undercounter, drawer, upright and preparation cabinets

Tell us if the issue affects a door, drawer, upper preparation area or the entire unit.

​

Polar display, counter and storage cabinets

Specify whether you are dealing with a refrigerated display, solid-door refrigerator or freezer.

​

FED or FED-X commercial equipment

Give the complete brand and model from the rating plate, rather than identifying the appliance by its supplier alone.

If you are responsible for several refrigerators, label the affected unit clearly in your booking request. A photo of its front and accessible identification plate will reduce confusion when the technician arrives. Mention any site restrictions on attendance, especially if the cabinet sits in a food preparation zone that is in use during service.

Skipio fridge repair for preparation and undercounter equipment

Skipio's Australian commercial equipment range includes upright cabinets, undercounter refrigerators and freezers, drawer units and salad or sandwich preparation counters. A refrigerator fitted underneath a work surface may be exposed to steam and heat from adjoining equipment; a preparation counter can experience frequent interruptions while staff replenish ingredients and open its lid.

​

Skipio preparation counter losing temperature at the top

If ingredients in the upper preparation area are warming while the refrigerated storage section underneath seems reasonably cold, examine the problem separately in each zone. Overfilled pans, unsuitable inserts, a lid left open unnecessarily or an obstructed circulation path may influence conditions, depending on the cabinet design. Not all prep counters distribute cold air in the same manner.

Check the operating instructions for the approved pan arrangement and load level. Take food temperatures using your venue's appropriate measuring procedure, not just the temperature of the air beneath the counter. Remove potentially hazardous ingredients that cannot be held safely and record which parts of the unit are affected. If both sections are compromised, tell us; that can change the direction of the investigation.

A technician may assess the upper section's airflow, local temperature sensing and the cooling system's ability to maintain the intended conditions. The exact procedure depends on the model. We avoid prescribing a universal fan or controller replacement merely because the top section is warm.

​

Skipio underbench fridge or freezer not cooling

During a busy shift, an underbench cabinet can be opened and closed repeatedly. A door that fails to close flush or a drawer that stops just short of its frame allows warm air to enter. A gradual rise in temperature may also coincide with deliveries, heavy loading or obstructed ventilation. These are observations to share, not proof that the refrigerator is free of mechanical faults.

For a dual-temperature Skipio unit, identify whether the refrigerated section, frozen section or both have changed. A technician can use that information alongside the model configuration to determine which cooling or control functions need examination. Do not lower all the settings in response to a single warm compartment. First protect food and record the current conditions.

Polar fridge repair for foodservice displays and counters

Polar supplies commercial refrigeration across its C, G and U product ranges. Their suitability for a particular duty depends on the model specifications and installation environment. A cabinet sold for a comparatively light workload cannot be assumed to have the same operating capacity as one designed for heavy commercial service. Selecting the right equipment and maintaining it correctly are both important to achieving reliable temperatures.

​

Polar glass-door display fridge is warm

For retail or hospitality staff, the first sign may be bottles that are no longer chilled or packaged food that has reached an unsuitable temperature. The door can remain visibly clear while refrigeration performance is already deteriorating. Check whether the cabinet is surrounded by heat sources, whether its ventilation openings are obstructed and whether stock has been arranged according to its loading instructions.

Different products have different storage requirements. A display cabinet used for packaged drinks should not automatically be relied upon to keep potentially hazardous foods at their required temperature. Verify the equipment's intended use and measure actual food temperatures if such food is stored there.

If a glass-door cabinet is misting up excessively, consider the closure, surrounding humidity and cabinet temperature alongside the refrigeration complaint. Persistent condensation can be a separate symptom rather than confirmation of a gas leak. We assess the door assembly, controller and cooling performance as indicated by the fault.

​

Polar counter fridge or upright freezer with recurring ice

Polar's operating instructions for different counter and storage cabinet models identify a range of possible contributors to abnormal temperatures, including loading, closure and ventilation. In practice, a freezer with recurrent heavy frost may require inspection of its sealing, defrost arrangement and circulation. Record where the ice accumulates and whether staff have noticed a change in how the door closes.

Follow the specific appliance instructions for maintenance and isolation. Do not use a knife to clear ice, pour hot water around powered equipment or remove an internal cover while the unit is operating. If the cabinet cannot hold its load at the required temperature, relocate stock and arrange service. A temporary improvement after defrosting should be reported to the technician, because it may help identify the reason the symptom returned.

For glass-door cabinets of any make, see our display fridge repair service.

FED fridge repairs and FED-X commercial refrigeration

Food Equipment Distributors supplies equipment across a range of product families, and FED-X is among its commercial refrigeration ranges. The cabinet's full model identification is more useful to a technician than the distributor's initials alone. Two stainless-steel preparation counters can look nearly identical but have different refrigeration components, settings and replacement part requirements.

​

FED-X salad, sandwich or pizza preparation station not holding temperature

A preparation cabinet combines refrigerated ingredient access with the working conditions of a busy food service area. Staff may refill pans repeatedly, leave the lid raised during orders and use the bench to stage ingredients before assembly. If the appliance has been holding ingredients safely under those conditions and suddenly cannot do so, document the change.

The lower compartment may still appear cold even when ingredients in the upper section are warming. Check the food temperatures in both locations and follow the specified loading arrangement. Avoid placing extra containers above the intended fill level or obstructing openings with improvised liners. If the problem persists under normal approved use, the equipment may need a more detailed cooling and control assessment.

Tell us whether the counter is a salad bench, a pizza preparation unit or another configuration. Provide the model and a photograph of the arrangement when booking. This helps distinguish a problem with the equipment's intended storage function from a mismatch between its design and the way it is being used.

​

FED upright refrigerators, freezers and chef-base drawers

Where a cabinet sits beneath cooking equipment or in a narrow counter run, heat exposure and ventilation are especially relevant. Do not assume every stainless-steel refrigerated drawer can be installed directly under any hot appliance. Installation instructions and the cabinet's intended environment determine suitable clearances and protection.

If the machine struggles mainly while nearby cooking equipment is active, describe that operating pattern to the technician. A fault may have reduced the refrigeration system's capacity, but the surrounding environment may also be contributing. We check the equipment in context so the repair addresses the actual problem rather than treating each high temperature reading as an isolated incident.

​

When a commercial refrigerator has power but is no longer cold

A cabinet with a lit display and a working interior lamp can still have a substantial cooling problem. It may be unable to reject heat, unable to circulate chilled air effectively or unable to operate a necessary refrigeration component. A thermostat or controller can also receive an inaccurate reading or fail to communicate the required operating command.

For a Skipio, Polar or FED cabinet, our assessment begins with the symptoms and the equipment identification. We consider the set point, measured conditions and the circumstances of the failure. A fridge that warms only after an unusually large delivery is not necessarily presenting the same fault as one that remains warm throughout the night with the doors closed.

Depending on the findings, technical examination may involve fans, sensing equipment, the heat rejection system, defrost components, electrical controls and the refrigerant circuit. A cabinet that is warm does not automatically require regassing. If evidence points to a leak or sealed-system fault, appropriate technical work is required to establish the cause and determine whether the repair is worthwhile. The refrigerant specified on the equipment must be considered; some modern commercial models use flammable refrigerants that require appropriate handling and safety measures.

Controller displays, alarm history and intermittent faults

01

An error indication is useful evidence, particularly if the equipment appears to recover before the service visit. Photograph the display with the exact characters visible, and record the time and circumstances. Some controllers can indicate a temporary operating condition rather than a failed part. A defrost-related display, for example, may not have the same meaning as an alarm reporting a persistent temperature rise.

02

Do not assume a code on a Polar model is identical to a code on a Skipio or FED appliance, even if the controllers look similar. The meaning can depend on the controller type and manufacturer configuration. Access to the correct operating or service information is necessary to interpret it properly. We do not recommend replacing a sensor or board solely because a generic online code list suggests it.

03

If employees have changed settings to keep the unit running, record those changes for the technician. Avoid entering service menus or altering protective timings without qualified guidance. The aim is to preserve useful evidence and prevent an inappropriate setting from creating additional faults. Where a controller fault is suspected, we assess its relationship to actual temperatures and the components it operates.

A safe action plan for the first minutes of a breakdown

The priority is to keep affected food from becoming unsafe while you arrange refrigeration assistance. Staff should know which person is responsible for making stock decisions and where suitable alternative refrigerated storage is located. Having a plan before a breakdown reduces confusion when a cabinet fails unexpectedly.

Check food temperatures with an appropriate calibrated thermometer, record the time and identify how long the temperature may have been outside the required range. Move eligible stock promptly, keeping the receiving unit within its capacity. Do not combine affected ingredients with fresh deliveries or erase existing labels and time records. If a batch's temperature history is unclear, refer to your food safety supervisor or procedures before deciding whether it can be used.

For potentially hazardous cold food, NSW Food Authority guidance uses 5°C or below as the usual temperature-control requirement. When applying the two-hour/four-hour rule for time between 5°C and 60°C, count the total accumulated time: under two hours may permit return to refrigeration, two to under four hours means use immediately, and four hours or longer requires disposal. Follow any stricter requirements for your operation or product. Restoring the refrigerator later does not reverse unsafe food handling that has already occurred.

If there is electrical tripping, smoke, a burning smell or water around a live connection, stop using the cabinet and arrange safe isolation. Do not attempt to keep the equipment trading by resetting a protective device repeatedly.

​

Door and drawer closure repairs for high-use cabinets

A preparation or underbench refrigerator can experience hundreds of opening cycles over time. The first visible defect may be a worn gasket or a drawer that no longer sits squarely. A gap in closure allows the cabinet to take on additional heat and moisture. It may also lead to condensation around the opening and extra operating time for the cooling system.

Observe whether the door closes consistently without staff having to push it twice. Remove any packaging or utensils that are obstructing closure. Check accessible sealing surfaces during approved routine cleaning, looking for hardened, split or detached sections. The gasket may not be the only contributor: worn runners, hinges, cabinet damage and misalignment can all affect the result.

We assess the closure assembly and match proposed replacement parts to the equipment's model. If a door or drawer requires additional hardware, that work is included in the discussion before approval. A seal selected merely by its external dimensions may not be suitable. For a cabinet with significant frame damage, it may be necessary to compare repair with replacement rather than repeatedly changing the gasket.

Cleaning and ventilation without creating a second problem

01

Commercial refrigeration works in environments where flour, grease, dust and food debris can accumulate. A condenser or filter obstructed by contamination can make heat rejection less effective. Routine maintenance should follow the unit's specific operating manual, including its instructions on isolation and accessible cleaning points. Polar, for instance, provides care instructions for its cabinet and counter models; use the manual for your actual appliance rather than another product in the range.

02

Do not direct a hose, pressure cleaner or chemical spray into ventilation openings. Electrical assemblies and fan equipment may be located behind the grille. If cleaning cannot be performed safely from an approved access point, arrange a service visit. Check that boxes and spare equipment have not been stored against the air inlet or exhaust route, and report any recent alteration to the cabinet's surroundings.

03

Consider documenting cleaning dates and faults on a simple equipment register. A recurrent temperature rise following a particular cleaning process or layout change can provide useful clues. For planned servicing across multiple brands, our commercial fridge maintenance service can be discussed separately from a one-off breakdown visit.

Planning routine care for several cabinets? See our commercial fridge maintenance service.

How to decide whether a Skipio, Polar or FED cabinet is worth repairing

Consider the whole operating situation. A sound unit with an identifiable closure, sensing or fan fault may be an attractive candidate for repair. A heavily damaged cabinet, recurring major refrigeration failures or parts that cannot be sourced could make replacement more appropriate. The equipment's remaining useful function matters as much as the price of the immediate component.

For a prep station, replacement might involve new pans, a change to the bench layout and revised working arrangements. An upright cabinet may require a delivery route through a narrow doorway or a temporary interruption to a storeroom. These practical considerations should be weighed alongside a repair quotation. On the other hand, a refrigerator that was never suitable for the workload may remain unsuitable even after a fault has been rectified.

​

We explain the diagnosed problem, the proposed work and any limitations. For an uncommon component, confirm sourcing time before deciding how to organise the next service period. Where the cabinet cannot be returned to reliable operation immediately, arrange adequate alternative storage. Avoid relying on an unconfirmed parts delivery date to decide whether potentially hazardous food can be retained.

Commercial refrigeration attendance, quotations and approval

When booking, identify the venue, affected cabinet, operating temperature, displayed warning and urgency. Include the model label, whether access is from the front or rear, and the contact details of the person authorised to approve work. Let us know if the cabinet must be isolated through a site procedure or if attendance needs to be coordinated with a facilities manager.

Our advertised starting call-out fee is $69; confirm the amount applicable to your commercial equipment and appointment. The complete repair quotation is provided after diagnosis. Ask about applicable charges, parts sourcing and the repair warranty before authorising work. Where a cabinet is covered by a supplier or manufacturer agreement, clarify those arrangements first. We are independent of Skipio, Polar and FED and do not claim to perform their authorised warranty service.

Following approved work, the technician checks relevant operation. Your venue should verify that the cabinet has regained suitable and stable storage conditions before reloading food that requires temperature control. Keep the invoice, diagnosis and corrective action with the equipment register; this makes recurring problems easier to investigate and helps managers monitor repair expenditure.

Frequently asked questions about Skipio, Polar and FED repairs

Why is my Skipio prep fridge warm at the top but cold underneath?

The upper ingredient area and lower storage cabinet may experience different heat loads or airflow conditions. Check the approved pan layout and measure food temperatures in both areas. Persistent warming can require investigation of circulation, sensing or refrigeration performance. Move affected ingredients to suitable storage and provide the model when booking.

Can you repair a Polar glass-door display refrigerator?

We assess Polar display cabinet cooling, temperature fluctuations, closure problems and related refrigeration faults, subject to the specific model and parts access. Tell us whether it stores drinks or food requiring temperature control. A display reading alone is insufficient to establish food safety. Protect stock while arranging an assessment.

Do you service FED-X commercial preparation counters?

We accept FED-X refrigeration enquiries for preparation counters, underbench cabinets and other commercial configurations. The precise model and fault determine service capability and the parts required. Send the identification details and describe which part of the cabinet is affected. We confirm the appropriate next step before committing to specialist work.

What does an error code on my commercial fridge mean?

The meaning depends on the cabinet and its controller configuration. Some indications refer to operating conditions, while others identify faults that require further testing. Photograph the code and record the actual symptoms rather than changing service parameters. A technician can use the correct model information to interpret the warning accurately.

Is a refrigerant recharge the solution for a warm Polar or Skipio fridge?

Not necessarily. Inadequate cooling can result from closure, airflow, heat rejection, electrical controls or refrigeration circuit problems. Refrigerant loss must be investigated rather than assumed from cabinet temperature alone. A suitable technician determines whether sealed-system work is appropriate and whether a confirmed leak can be repaired safely and economically.

Can I keep trading while a prep fridge is waiting for repair?

Trading arrangements depend on whether your business can maintain safe food handling and adequate alternative cold storage. Do not continue using a cabinet that cannot hold ingredients safely. Follow your food safety procedures, document affected stock and apply the appropriate time and temperature guidance. The responsible person must assess operational suitability.

Can you attend on the same day if my commercial cabinet fails?

Same-day attendance may be available depending on location, scheduling and urgency. A prompt visit can establish the fault, but completion depends on suitable parts and safe access. Provide the model, temperature readings and any food safety impact when booking. Arrange alternative storage rather than relying on a guaranteed repair time.

Do you provide authorised warranty repairs for Polar, Skipio or FED?

Fridge Repairs Blacktown is an independent refrigeration repair business, not an authorised warranty representative for these brands. If the equipment is covered by its supplier or manufacturer, contact them before commissioning chargeable work. For other repairs, we assess the fault, explain the options and confirm our own applicable warranty terms.
